runs.name: American States Water Company; NYSE AWR, SEC CIK 0001056903; holding company of Golden State Water Company, a CPUC-regulated California water utility with about 265,100 customer connections, Bear Valley Electric Service, CPUC-regulated electricity to about 24,900 connections in San Bernardino County mountain communities, and American States Utility Services, water and wastewater services to U.S. military bases under 50-year firm-fixed-price contracts; ATM equity distribution agreement amended 2026-02-20 and its $200M limit reached 2026-06-12; CPUC approval to defer GSWC's cost of capital application 2025-11-19; $100M GSWC private placement notes 2025-05-29; the 10-K names no rival, California Water Service, H2O America (formerly SJW) and Essential Utilities chosen as a CONVENTION of the run
runs.box: OUT AT Q7, ON THE FLOOR
runs.entry: The v5 re-run order, unattended work-hours cycle, one dispatched analyst under the canonical brief, from scratch. The brief's departures: the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25; the lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the FY2025 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7 (the three segments; competition and condemnation; the loss of WRAM and MCBA decoupling from 2025; wildfire strict liability at BVES; contamination; California concentration; ASUS fixed-price and appropriations risk; the cost of capital; the ATM program; capital spending against depreciation; the dividend policy); competitors chosen by the analyst as a CONVENTION because the 10-K names none, American Water Works left out because its v5 run subject was seen at session start. Price **$85.48** (close 2026-10-27, aggregator, flagged) x **39,635,626 shares** (10-Q cover as of 2026-08-04, accession 0001628280-26-053401; no treasury shares; the tool's second line, 178 shares, is GSWC's own stock held by AWR, not a second class) = cap **$3,388M**; sovereign **5.30%** (Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-27). **Q1 IN** (water 77.6% of five-year segment operating income, $661.1M of $851.9M; electric 7.1%, contracted services 15.3%). **Q2 IN on the franchise** (GSWC territories "substantially free from direct and indirect competition"; CPUC 7.93% on rate base, 10.06% on equity, 57% equity and 43% debt, held through 2027 by the deferral; the regulator-set return carried to Q3 as a second best; against: WRAM and MCBA removed in the 2025 to 2027 rate case, California regulatory climate); ten-year mean ROE AWR 13.5% against California Water Service 8.9%, H2O America 7.6%, Essential 9.5%, higher than each in at least eight of ten years. **Q3 weighs for, weakly** (about 7.2% after tax on capital added since 2020). **Q4 IN on the accounts, weighs slightly against** (no restatement, control effective; featured adjusted EPS and a 2026 ASUS EPS forecast of $0.63 to $0.67 carried to Q5). **Q5 IN** (CEO since 2009 holding 204,955 shares, about 18 times salary; independent chair). **Q6 weighs against, mildly** (dividend growth target above 7% a year while 2,575,947 ATM shares were sold at about $77.64; no buybacks, no deals). **Q7 OUT, on the floor and above the top of the range**: equity-only central (a regulated utility); owner cash FY2021 to FY2025 after the depreciation guess **$104.7M a year**, -$45.3M after all spending (capital spending $193.6M a year against depreciation $43.6M); growth shown 23.2% cut to sales growth of 7.17% under (f), then to the 5.30% discount rate; growth spending $158.0M in year one to $251.4M in year ten; utility debt credit $64.50M a year at the 43% allowed debt share (long-term debt rising $70.01M a year), binding. Value range **$49.86 to $54.71 a share equity-only (central)**; maintenance owner cash 3.09% of the market value at the price; **fair price $23.67 equity-only, central**; all-equity range $36.65 to $40.93, fair $3.52 beside; base variants (one rate cycle, seven years, regulatory balances removed) give tops of $41 to $59, all OUT. Facts after the stop recorded, not weighed. Balance sheet FY2017 to FY2025: assets $1,417M to $2,715M and equity $530M to $1,046M, from retained earnings and from 2024 new shares; no goodwill; bank notes peaked at $334M in 2023 in the late rate case and were termed out to $141M in 2025; about $106M due from the U.S. government plus contract assets against $137M of ASUS revenue; pre-tax interest cover 4.0x to 4.9x 2023 to 2025; GSWC debt to capitalization 0.4352 under a 0.6667 covenant. Strongest evidence against, as the analyst put it: inverse-condemnation strict liability for fire damage and BVES in a high wildfire risk area, all regulated operations in southern California; operating cash never covered capital spending plus dividends in any year of the window; the regulator moved volume and supply-mix risk onto the owners in 2025. Framework gaps for the operator: specific (a) does not fit a rate-case cycle, and whether regulatory assets and liabilities are working capital under (d); the maintenance guess for a utility whose renewal spending earns a return like growth spending, and how the debt credit classes it; (f) capped at the discount rate makes the growth case nearly the no-growth case; "capped at the allowed debt share" open to two readings; the all-equity fair price for a utility near zero says little. Could not get: a maintenance and growth split of capital spending, credit ratings, any 8-K after 2026-08-05 (none listed). Analyst's commits: pathspec commits of its own paths, one per question, last `69a4308e`. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; no E-ids, every id in the ledger, no citation slip, 19 adjacent fragment pairs checked by `dispatcher_cite_check.py`, three checker mispairings resolved by hand (the framework's own Q2 wording, a 10-K pension sentence and a 10-Q guidance sentence, each sourced in the text beside the id); no tracked research file over 200 KB. Contamination declared: AWK v5 run commit subjects with its box and range at session start, and memory index lines; none used. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Armed at the equity-only fair price.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7 on the floor: a California water utility with a small mountain electric utility and military-base contracts, the castle standing on CPUC franchises with the best ten-year return on equity of its listed peers, but owner cash is negative after all spending and maintenance owner cash is 3.09% of the price; value range $49.86 to $54.71 equity-only against $85.48. Fair $23.67 equity-only, central; all-equity $3.52 beside; armed.
